title: Kodeeswaran 3
desc: After succeeding at framing ACP Kishore, Satya goes on to become an international criminal. While he gets targeted by Interpol, Kishore seeks revenge on him too, upon being released from prison.

title: Yennai Arindhaal
desc: Sathyadev, an honest police officer, is on a mission to stop an organ trafficking racket, unaware that the mastermind is the same person who killed his beloved.

title: Achaneyanenikkishtam
desc: Battling financial hardship, a lorry driver navigates life's obstacles as he strives to give his son the best education.

title: Vivegam
desc: Ajay Kumar, a former counter-terrorism agent, is called for a special mission. However, he is betrayed by his friends and is accused of extremely treasonous acts.

title: Gajakesari
desc: Krishna protects the tribal people of the Aanegudde forest from Rana, a local thug, who plans to throw them out of their houses to build a resort there.
